page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, configured with 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core. Notably, this instance includes a fractional GPU allocation consisting of 0.0833 of an NVIDIA A10 GPU, which provides 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage and features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1884.98 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1595.0. However, multi-core performance is weak, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 5733.3 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4061.0. Memory bandwidth is average for cached read-only small blocks at 421.08 GB/sec, but Passmark memory performance is poor, scoring 1096.88. In terms of specialized workloads, the fractional GPU configuration delivers average performance for small LLM inference using a 135M model at 117.31 tokens/sec for text generation, but struggles with larger models, yielding a poor 4.57 tokens/sec for a 7B model.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is defined by its fractional GPU model, which allows access to hardware-accelerated graphics and compute resources without the expense of a full GPU. The primary tradeoff is the limited 2 GB of VRAM and the weak multi-core CPU scaling, which restricts its utility for heavy parallel processing or large-scale AI models. This server is suited for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, entry-level virtual workstations, basic image processing, and small-scale language model inference.
